meta.name: North East
meta.eyebrow: Newcastle, Gateshead, North Tyneside, South Tyneside, Sunderland, County Durham and Northumberland
meta.counts_blurb: Average bikes per day at the busiest DfT traffic count points inside the North East, 2021–25 (only points manually counted at least once). Most are single weekday counts on main roads, so weekend leisure riding is undercounted and off-road paths are not covered. Leeds is the only area here with open data from automatic council counters.
